data_security_requirements.quote: ICBC maintains a zero-trust approach to all information security initiatives based on the principles of least privilege, monitoring and alerting, and continuous network security verification. All cloud services must adhere to the zero-trust approach and follow a recognized security standard such as ISO 27001.
value: Separation between tenants as well as users
Identity authentication and authorization with clear role-based access and support for MFA
Comprehensive logging allowing for the clear identification of users, their access, creation, modifications, and destruction of ICBC data in a transparent manner along with actionable diagnostics.
Ability to integrate with a security monitoring solution (i.e. Splunk)

vendor_demonstration_required.quote: Shortlisted Proponents, including both the OEM and SI, are expected to present their proposals in-person at an ICBC office in the Lower Mainland.
